source.member: CreatureAttribute, CreatureVital and CreatureSkill members, AttributeFormula.GetFormula, Creature.GetCreatureSkill/GetCreatureVital
source.notes: in describes the biota: attributes[i] = [init, ranks, cp] for Strength..Self (null = absent, the ctor adds it); vitals[i] = [init, ranks, cp, current] for MaxHealth, MaxStamina, MaxMana; skills = [id, sac, init, ranks, pp]; ints/floats = [property, value]; player selects the Player class. out.attributes[i] = [Base, Current, GetCurrent(false), ModifierType, ExperienceLeft, IsMaxRank, StartingValue, Ranks, ExperienceSpent]; out.vitals[i] = [Base, MaxValue, GetMaxValue(false), Missing, Percent, ExperienceLeft, IsMaxRank, RegenRate, ToEnum, ModifierType, Current, StartingValue, Ranks]; out.skills maps each probe skill to GetCreatureSkill(skill, false) = null or [IsUsable, Base, Current, ExperienceLeft, IsMaxRank, AdvancementClass, player ? GetAugBonus_Base : null, player ? GetAugBonus_Current : null]; out.formula_skill maps each probe skill to [GetFormula(current), GetFormula(base)]; out.formula_vital[v] for PropertyAttribute2nd 0..6; out.get_creature_vital[v] is GetCreatureVital(v).Vital or null ({"skipped":true} for a player's odd v, whose error log reads Player.Name); out.attribute_mod[i] is GetAttributeMod(vital) for the three vitals.
